listing_conflicts.note: Maximum temperature: the page title says '450°F Hi-Fry Option'; the bullet copy on the same page says 'a temperature range from 200-400°F'. Both readings are from the same listing on the same day.

Product-name string: the live <title> element ('TurboFry 4-in-1 with 450°F Hi-Fry') differs from the name captured for this ASIN earlier ('TurboFry Touch ... One-Touch Digital Control Presets'). Amazon serves different name strings for the same detail page depending on the variant shown.

Size variations: the page offers 6 / 8 / 9 quart variants under one ASIN and currently shows 8 quarts selected. A buyer can land on a different size from the same link, so check the size selector on the page you are sent to.
Amazon's own page states 'There is a newer model of this item' and shows the Chefman Air Fryer 6 QT Compact (B0CNY1YVDD). Worth reading before paying for an older generation.

faq: Which size will I actually get?

The ASIN is a size family: the page offers 6, 8 and 9 quarts and was showing 8 quarts selected on 2026-11-20, with the details table reading 'Capacity: 8 quarts'. Check the size selector on the page you land on, because the same link can carry a different size (FLG-023).
How much power does it draw?

The listing bullet reads '1000 Watts/120 Volts - RJ38-SQSS-8T'. An earlier capture of this page in this repo carried 1700 W, which is the wattage printed on the 6-quart Chefman listing; it was corrected on 2026-11-20 and the earlier value is kept beside the correction (FLG-022).

The page title says '450F Hi-Fry Option' while the bullet copy on the same page says a temperature range from 200-400F. Both strings are shown on the specs table rather than one of them being quietly chosen (FLG-005).
